extension.summary: A rustic-cinema skin: dark, warm and image-rich, like a home theater lit by a fireplace.
extension.description: Hearthfire turns Kodi into a log-cabin screening room. Ember Rim focus, a timber-and-brass Mantel navigation rail, a unified Firelight fanart grade, Lights Down/Up theater ritual on playback, and a considered ticket-stub Intermission screen replace the usual flat, cool, borrowed-art look of most skins with one warm, confident, original design system. Built for a dark room, a big screen and a remote.
extension.news: v0.1.0 - Initial foundation: tokens, fonts, colors, components, backdrop stack, Home, shared dialogs, Ledger settings shell, Weather, library view family, playback Booth/OSD/Intermission, Skin Settings.
